School.title: School
School.description: Represents a school, containing its unique identity and general board configuration settings.

id.description: Unique identifier for the School entity.

name.description: The official name of the school, e.g., '1st Public School'.

logoUrl.description: URL to the school's logo image, displayed on the board.

themeColor.description: Primary color for the school's board in hexadecimal format (e.g., '#30475E').

accentColor.description: Accent color for interactive elements and highlights in hexadecimal format (e.g., '#6A4C93').

backgroundColor.description: Background color for the school's board in hexadecimal format (e.g., '#F0F4F8').

bellSoundUrlDefault.description: URL for the default bell sound played at lesson start/end times.

Lesson.title: Lesson
Lesson.description: Defines a scheduled lesson period within a school's bell schedule.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Lesson entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this lesson belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N Lesson)

lessonNumber.description: The sequential number of the lesson in the daily schedule (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

startTime.description: Start time of the lesson in HH:MM format (e.g., '08:30').

endTime.description: End time of the lesson in HH:MM format (e.g., '09:15').

bellSoundUrlOverride.description: Optional URL for a specific bell sound for this lesson, overriding the school's default. (Relationship: Lesson N:1 File)

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: Content displayed on the school's information board, excluding calendar events.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Announcement entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this announcement belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N Announcement)

title.description: The main title or headline of the announcement.

description.description: The full text content of the announcement.

imageUrl.description: Optional URL for an image related to the announcement.

displayOrder.description: The numerical order in which the announcement should appear within a group or slider.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the announcement is currently active and visible on the board.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the announcement was first created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the announcement was last updated.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents a scheduled event for the school calendar, displayed on the information board.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Event entity.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this event belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N Event)

imageUrl.description: Optional URL for an image associated with the event.

startDate.description: Start date and time of the event.

endDate.description: End date and time of the event.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the event is currently active and should be displayed on the board.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the event was created.

AdminActionLog.title: AdminActionLog
AdminActionLog.description: Records administrative actions performed within a school's board management system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AdminActionLog entry.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School where the action occurred. (Relationship: School 1:N AdminActionLog)

adminIdentifier.description: An identifier for the administrator who performed the action (e.g., a user ID from an external authentication system).

entityType.description: The type of entity affected by the action (e.g., 'Lesson', 'Announcement', 'School').

entityId.description: The ID of the specific entity instance that was acted upon. (Relationship: AdminActionLog N:1 various entities)

timestamp.description: Date and time when the action was performed.

details.description: A JSON string containing specific details of the change, such as old and new values, for auditing purposes.

AnnouncementVersion.title: AnnouncementVersion
AnnouncementVersion.description: Stores historical versions of announcements for backup, preview, and restore functionality.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AnnouncementVersion entry.

announcementId.description: Reference to the original Announcement this version belongs to. (Relationship: Announcement 1:N AnnouncementVersion)

schoolId.description: Reference to the School the announcement belongs to. (Relationship: School 1:N AnnouncementVersion)

versionNumber.description: A sequential number identifying this version of the announcement.

snapshotData.description: The full JSON string representation of the announcement's state at this version.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this version was saved.

modifiedByIdentifier.description: Identifier of the administrator who triggered this version save.

EmergencyAnnouncement.title: EmergencyAnnouncement
EmergencyAnnouncement.description: Manages a school's urgent, temporary announcement that overlays the main content.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EmergencyAnnouncement entity. Can be a fixed ID if only one emergency announcement is active per school.

schoolId.description: Reference to the School this emergency announcement applies to. (Relationship: School 1:1 EmergencyAnnouncement)

title.description: The title of the emergency message.

description.description: Detailed content of the emergency message.

imageUrl.description: Optional URL for an image related to the emergency announcement.

isActive.description: True if the emergency announcement is currently active and should be displayed.

activatedAt.description: Timestamp when the emergency announcement was activated.

deactivatedAt.description: Optional timestamp when the emergency announcement was deactivated.

definition.description: Dedicated collection for managing school administrative roles. The existence of a document at this path signifies that the '{userId}' is an administrator for the '{schoolId}'. This structure ensures Authorization Independence by allowing rules to use `exists()` checks for admin access without querying parent data.

params.name: schoolId
params.description: The unique identifier of the school.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the Firebase authenticated user.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure for the SchoolSync Board application is designed around a hierarchical model, with each school serving as the root for its related data. This approach ensures clear ownership, simplified security rules, and efficient real-time updates.The core design principle of **Authorization Independence (CRITICAL)** is achieved through two main strategies. Firstly, for all school-specific subcollections (e.g., 'lessons', 'announcements', 'events'), the `schoolId` is explicitly included in the document path (`/schools/{schoolId}/...`) and within the document itself. This allows security rules to evaluate access based directly on the path parameter, eliminating the need for `get()` operations on parent documents to determine the school context.Secondly, administrative authorization is decoupled from the `School` document's content. Instead of embedding admin roles within each `School` document or its subcollection documents (which would necessitate complex denormalization updates or `get()` calls), a separate, dedicated collection `/school_admins/{schoolId}/authorizedUsers/{userId}` is used. Security rules can efficiently check the `exists()` of a document at this path to determine if `request.auth.uid` is an administrator for a given `schoolId`. This pattern ensures atomicity, avoids cascading updates, and prevents `get()` calls, adhering strictly to authorization independence.For **QAPs (Rules are not Filters)**, the structure facilitates secure `list` operations while acknowledging the limitations of Firestore rules in filtering results. For public-facing board data (lessons, announcements, events, emergency announcements), `read` access is granted to all users who have 'entered' a school (which is currently gated by a client-side password check, not Firebase Auth rules). Crucially, the application client is responsible for applying display filters (e.g., `isActive == true`, date ranges for events). This is acceptable for board content, as revealing an inactive item is typically a UI/UX concern rather than a security breach. Administrative collections (e.g., `adminActionLogs`, `announcementVersions`) are strictly protected, allowing `list` and `read` only to authenticated school administrators, aligning with their sensitive nature.The design also adheres to **Structural Segregation** by grouping all school-specific data under `/schools/{schoolId}`, ensuring a homogeneous security posture within each school's domain. **Access Modeling** utilizes hierarchical paths for school-owned data and an existence-based pattern for user roles. **Data Clarity and Predictability** are maintained through explicit state fields like `isActive`, consistent naming, and descriptive wildcards, ensuring the database schema is intuitive and debuggable.
